_metadata.description: Google Cloud Compute Engine (GCE) hardware capability and monthly pricing catalog.
_metadata.pricingAssumptions: Monthly pricing is estimated in USD assuming 730 active hours per month per region. Omitted pricing fields indicate unsupported tiers for that VM shape.
_metadata.storageAssumptions: Storage performance limits (maxIOPS, maxThroughputMBps) per supported volume type. Omitted disk types indicate unsupported storage for that VM shape.

fields.localSSDGiB: Total direct-attached Local NVMe SSD storage capacity in GiB (0 if none)

storage.description: Per-instance max IOPS and throughput (MB/s) for supported Google Cloud Persistent Disk and Hyperdisk volume types (omitted if unsupported)
storage.hyperdisk-balanced: Hyperdisk Balanced storage performance limits (maxIOPS, maxThroughputMBps)
storage.hyperdisk-balanced-ha: Hyperdisk Balanced High Availability storage performance limits (maxIOPS, maxThroughputMBps)

networking.defaultMaxEgressGbps: Standard default network egress bandwidth limit in Gbps
networking.tier1MaxEgressGbps: Tier_1 / higher bandwidth network egress limit in Gbps (0 if unavailable)

pricing.description: Estimated monthly costs in USD assuming 730 hours/month per region (omitted if tier is unavailable)
pricing.onDemandMonthlyUSD: Standard On-Demand / pay-as-you-go monthly price in USD
pricing.spotMonthlyUSD: Spot / Preemptible VM monthly price in USD
pricing.cud1YrMonthlyUSD: 1-Year Committed Use Discount (1y CUD) monthly price in USD
pricing.cud3YrMonthlyUSD: 3-Year Committed Use Discount (3y CUD) monthly price in USD
pricing.dwsCalendarMonthlyUSD: Dynamic Workload Scheduler (DWS) Calendar Mode monthly price in USD
pricing.dwsDurationMonthlyUSD: Dynamic Workload Scheduler (DWS) Defined Duration Mode monthly price in USD
